bio: Argentine family cooking. Empanadas, milanesas, and a very serious chimichurri.
Cape Malay cooking from Bo-Kaap. Sweet, spiced and generous.
Kiwi and Māori home cooking. Boil-up, rēwena bread and kai moana.
Palestinian food, mostly vegetarian, always with bread.

Feeding three kids, one husband and a dog on a budget. Freezer is my best friend.

Filipino lola cooking. Adobo, sinigang and pancit for every birthday.
Tamil tiffin and sambar. Dosa batter always in the fridge.
Mexican in Sydney, making real tacos with what Coles has. It can be done.

Cooking my way through yiayia's handwritten notebook, one stain at a time.

bio: Andalusian in Perth. Small plates, big table.
